import markdown
from xml.etree import ElementTree as etree

# Debug: check what's happening in TocTreeprocessor.run
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])

original_run = md.registeredExtensions[0].TreeProcessorClass.run

def debug_run(self, doc):
    used_ids = set()
    for el in doc.iter():
        if "id" in el.attrib:
            used_ids.add(el.attrib["id"])
    
    for el in doc.iter():
        if isinstance(el.tag, str) and el.tag.startswith('h'):
            print(f"\nHeader {el.tag}:")
            print(f"  attrib={dict(el.attrib)}")
            
            # Check if id exists
            if "id" not in el.attrib:
                raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                print(f"  raw_label={raw_label!r}")
                
                if raw_label:
                    from markdown.util import code_escape
                    from markdown.extensions.toc import stashedHTML2text, striptags, html, unescape
                    
                    stripped_label = stashedHTML2text(code_escape(raw_label), self.md, strip_entities=False)
                    print(f"  stripped_label={stripped_label!r}")
                    slug_text = html.unescape(stripped_label)
                    print(f"  slug_text={slug_text!r}")
                else:
                    print(f"  No raw_label, using text path")
            else:
                print(f"  Already has id: {el.attrib['id']}")
    
    return original_run(self, doc)

md.registeredExtensions[0].TreeProcessorClass.run = debug_run

text = "# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}"
result = md.convert(text)
print("\nResult:")
print(result)
